verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents built-in AI that drafts content from a stated goal: its Composer "will build the audience, draft the content," and the product lists an "AI-powered subject line generator." Both are first-party marketing claims that cover the core of drafting subject lines and copy from a brief. Missing for 10: documented inline refine/rewrite of existing copy inside the email editor, detailed docs on how the brief-to-copy flow works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can have the platform's built-in AI draft or refine subject lines and email copy from a brief, inside the composer

citations.quote: Tell Composer what you're trying to achieve, and it'll build the audience, draft the content, and map out the send strategy.
Composer can make supported changes, build marketing for your review, and help carry the work through, with you in control.
